title: Raiders on the plain
place: Persia, the hot Rudbar (Jiroft) plain south of Kerman, below the mountain descent near ruined Camadi, on the road down to Hormuz, autumn of about 1272.

accuracy.source: Marco Polo, Travels, Yule-Cordier ed., Book 1 ch. 18 and notes 1-5 (Project Gutenberg #10636)
findings: A vast, very hot plain (Reobarles: Rudbar/Jiroft) with dates, pistachios and 'apples of Paradise'; turtledoves, francolins, white humped oxen, fat-tailed sheep.
Villages and towns 'have lofty walls of mud, made as a defence against the banditti'.

The Caraonas bring a darkness ('you can scarcely discern your comrade riding beside you'), ride abreast across the whole plain and catch every living thing outside the walls. The darkness is a dry dust haze or fog, typical after the autumn equinox (Sykes).
Marco threw himself into a village hard by, Conosalmi; he lost his whole company except seven (Pauthier's text).
Not in the source: the caravan's animals, flight on horseback, who spotted the raiders, the open gate. These are our reconstruction.
Raiders c.1272: Mongol (Negüderi) kit, wrap-over deel, quilted or fur-trimmed caps, composite recurve bow first, sabre and mace, some lamellar; small steppe horses 13-14 hands.

layout.status: Draft blocking from bart's note of 26 Nov 2026 (the village stays small on the far right until the Polos race toward it). The distances are a first proposal for bart to correct, not a reconstruction.

layout.light: warm low sun from behind the camera side (south), dimming once the haze rises

landmarks.label: walled village (Conosalmi)
landmarks.note: far to the east, on the right of frame: a walled village with lofty mud walls and one plain gate, not a town; about 3 km from the caravan until the chase

landmarks.label: brown haze, later the raiders
landmarks.note: far to the west, on the left of frame; a dry dust haze that rises in the clips and hides the sun, the raiders coming out of it as a broad line abreast; the stills show a clear horizon there

routes.label: the Polos: at a walk, then at a gallop east

cells.action: The guide has stopped and looks toward the left horizon; his horse lifts its head.
Marco, in the saddle, looks at the far left horizon; the plain there is still clear (the haze rises in the clip, not in the still).

where.marco: the rider seen from behind, close to the camera

cells.action: Niccolò and Marco side by side; Marco narrows his eyes, Niccolò looks past him, steady.

where.marco: the young man on the right
